name: The Shooting Star Addition
description: An unofficial addon for The Shooting Star. Adds two skills to the Stellar Remote, numbered after The Shooting Star's own (SS-06 Halley and SS-07 Luna with The Shooting Star 1.4.0). Halley: a comet called down onto your crosshair. It comes in low over the horizon, ploughs a frozen trench toward your mark and detonates on it, leaving an icy crater with the comet's glowing heart standing in it. Luna: the moon itself falls on your crosshair and stays there, a moon of edible moon cheese with a molten heart. Made for The Shooting Star (Demo) 1.4.0 on Fabric 1.21.11.
